title: Fix WhatsApp button to reflect updated phone number from admin panel

requirements.summary: Make FloatingWhatsApp component dynamically fetch the WhatsApp phone number from the backend and ensure the admin panel invalidates the cache when saving a new number
acceptanceCriteria: FloatingWhatsApp component reads the phone number from the site settings query result, not a hardcoded string.
When an admin updates and saves a new WhatsApp number in AdminSettings, the React Query cache for site settings is invalidated.
After saving a new number in the admin panel, the FloatingWhatsApp button opens a WhatsApp chat with the newly saved number without requiring a page reload.
If no number is returned from the backend, the button falls back to a sensible default rather than throwing an error.

file_operations.description: Replace the hardcoded phone number with a call to the useGetWhatsappNumber hook from useQueries.ts. Use the query result's data for the phone number, falling back to a default value (e.g., '+919876543210') when the query is loading or returns an empty string. Ensure the component handles loading and error states gracefully without breaking the UI.

After successfully saving the WhatsApp number via the setWhatsappNumber mutation, invalidate the React Query cache for the 'whatsappNumber' query key using queryClient.invalidateQueries. This ensures that any component using useGetWhatsappNumber (including FloatingWhatsApp) will refetch the updated value immediately. Add the invalidation call in the onSuccess callback of the mutation to ensure it triggers only after a successful save.
